name: Product Showcase
description: Your mascot becomes the host of its own keynote — presenting, demonstrating, and celebrating a hero product.

clips.prompt: {mascot_description} walks confidently into a bright minimalist studio with a glowing pedestal in the foreground. Soft cinematic lighting, slow tracking shot, premium tech vibe.
The mascot gestures toward the pedestal as a soft light beam appears above it. The character looks proud, smiles, and tilts head invitingly toward the camera.
Close-up of the mascot's expressive face reacting with delight as glowing UI elements and brand-color sparkles float around. Subtle parallax, premium product reveal feel.
The mascot points up and outwards as light rays expand from the pedestal area, bathing the scene in warm brand-colored glow. Cinematic, aspirational.
The mascot does a small celebratory hop and gives a thumbs up to the camera as confetti-like sparkles swirl gently around the frame.
The mascot strikes a confident final pose next to the glowing pedestal, looks toward the camera with a friendly smile. Slow camera pull-back, soft light bloom, polished outro.
